name: S Vul
description: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that pulsates every 68.71 days; its mean radius is 272.4 solar radii.

radius.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, S Vul: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 272.4 +/- 13.2 (Monte-Carlo)

temperature.source: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 159, Name='S Vul', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4625 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic)

gravity.source: Luck (2018), AJ 156, 171, VizieR J/AJ/156/171/table11, recno 52, Name='S Vul', column Gavg ('Average gravity over cycle'; log g in dex, ReadMe unit label cm/s2): log g 0.93 averaged over the pulsation cycle

distance.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, S Vul: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 3879.9 +/- 195.8 (Monte-Carlo)

color.reason: Interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.727 +/- 0.043 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation

text.card: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 68.7 days.
text.introduction: Its mean radius, 272.4 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 3,880 parsecs away.
text.locator: table10, S Vul: Per, Rad, Dist

notes: The star pulsates; it is drawn at its mean radius.
No dynamical mass is measured for this Cepheid; its mass is left unmeasured.
